text: {"lessons":["Realizing gains feels good, but I should not sell a holding automatically just because it is above my average cost; I should consider its role and outlook in my portfolio.","Repeatedly selling Stock D and Stock A at gains did not stop my account value from declining, so I should judge progress by the whole portfolio, not realized profits alone.","I rarely trade, and doing nothing can be reasonable; I should follow a consistent plan for both gains and losses rather than let loss aversion or short-term account changes drive decisions."]}
